verdict.rationale: Zep's `thread.add_messages` stores chat messages in the thread history and also ingests them into the user-level Context Graph, so memory persists beyond any single thread (session). The docs describe retrieving that memory with graph search that combines semantic similarity and BM25, plus Context Block retrieval, including returning context directly from `add_messages` via `return_context=True`. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of recall quality across sessions; the community items describe design intent rather than measured retrieval results.
